_comment: Header-only bulk regression corpus for mail-jxa.ts bulkReason (null = kept). Bulk cases are trimmed recordings from a real inbox (2026-11); person and transactional cases keep the header names real person-to-person, helpdesk and transactional mail carry. The rules lean towards keeping mail: List-Id alone, Precedence bulk/list alone and Auto-Submitted auto-generated/auto-notified are not bulk (a helpdesk agent's or a Jira comment must never be hidden). Addresses of private people are fictional.
